notes: Extremely compact Class II disk; ALMA Band 7 0.87 mm (Curone et al. 2026)

images.wavelength_label: 0.87 mm continuum (343.5 GHz; robust 0.5; resolved inner cavity and ring)

paper.title: Probing Planet Formation within 10 au: Dust Substructures in Extremely Compact Protoplanetary Disks

images.note: Panel label inside figure: Sz 112. R68 = 3.77 au (0.0239"). Clearest substructure in the sample: inner cavity resolved both in the image plane and in the frank model - cavity/inner ring edge at 1.6 au, ring peak B3 at 2.6 au (width 2.0 au). A cavity had been predicted from SED modelling (van der Marel et al. 2016) but was unresolved at ~5 au resolution before. Beam 19x13 mas = 3.0x2.1 au, PA_b = 89 deg; F_nu = 3.78 +/- 0.28 mJy; rms 47 uJy/beam. EBs 29 Jul and 04 Aug 2025; epoch = first EB.
